name: standing hip adduction v. 2
description: Standing leg swings across the body to work the inner thigh. A simple move for the adductors.
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or chair and hold on for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it across the front of your standing leg.
Return slowly to the start without leaning.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch legs.
